posts.title: The Rise of the Lonely Engineer
posts.description: In my post about multinational teams I wrote that a colleague’s silence in a meeting could mean at least six different things. posts.title: Working Effectively in Multinational Teams as an Engineer
posts.description: Early in my career, I assumed everyone worked the same way I did. I thought “professional” meant universal and that technical rigor transcended culture. I was not just incorrect, I was naively wrong . I’ve spent about twenty-five years working in infrastructure engineering, almost always in multinational distributed teams.
